reels.caption:
SUNSET STRIP | Los Angeles, CA

Perched above the famed Sunset Strip, this modern estate offers panoramic city-to-ocean views and seamless indoor-outdoor living. A gated drive leads to a central court connecting the main house, guest house, and a glass-walled garage—all linked by a striking water feature that flows to dual pools and a spa.

Inside, a soaring living room, chrome-and-stone staircase, wine cellar, and see-through fireplace set the tone. The kitchen and family room float above water, opening to expansive terraces and an infinity pool. A private wellness center, media lounge, and two lower-level guest suites complete the main residence, while the upstairs primary suite features motorized glass walls, dual baths, and the estate's best view.

A separate two-bedroom guest house adds privacy and flexibility. Finishes include warm stone, wood, Italian fixtures, and bronzed aluminum. Minutes from the Strip, yet completely serene.
